name: Page Fault Count Simulation (FIFO / LRU / OPT)
recognitionClueHinglish: Reference string aur frames diye hain aur page faults ya final frame contents poochi hain — sabse bada pattern (31 me se 14).
whatShouldComeToMind: Table banao, har reference pe hit/fault mark karo.
FIFO me hit pe order nahi badalta; LRU me hit pe recency badalti hai.
generalSolvingApproach: 1. Frames khali se shuru (jab tak alag na bataya ho).
2. Har reference: page frames me hai to hit, nahi to fault.
3. Fault pe frames bhare hain to algorithm ke rule se victim choose karo.
variationsObserved: Address sequence di hai (page number khud nikaalna: address / page size).
Modified OPT variant (custom rule) — rule ko sahi padhkar simulate karo.
Do algorithms (FIFO vs LRU) ki comparison.
commonTraps: LRU me hit par recency update na karna.
Address ko page number me convert karna bhool jaana.

name: Belady's Anomaly & Algorithm Properties
recognitionClueHinglish: Poocha hai kaunsa algorithm Belady's anomaly dikhata hai, ya frames badhane ka effect, ya OPT/LRU ki definition.
whatShouldComeToMind: LRU aur OPT stack algorithms hain, anomaly nahi.
generalSolvingApproach: 2. Stack-algorithm hai to anomaly nahi; FIFO hai to ho sakti hai.
3. Definition wale options me OPT = future me sabse der baad use, LRU = past me sabse der pehle use.
variationsObserved: Random replacement ke baare me statement (Belady possible/impossible) — random stack algorithm nahi hai.
commonTraps: 'Frames badhane par faults hamesha ghategi' — FIFO ke liye galat.

name: Concepts: Dirty Bit, Locality, Thrashing, Minimum Frames
recognitionClueHinglish: Definition/true-false: dirty bit ka kaam, locality of reference, thrashing, minimum frames, RAM badhane ka asar.
whatShouldComeToMind: Dirty bit unnecessary disk writes bachata hai.
generalSolvingApproach: 1. Concept ki standard definition yaad karo.
2. Har option ko definition se test karo.
variationsObserved: Paging external fragmentation hatati hai par internal fragmentation laati hai (page size se prabhavit).
commonTraps: Thrashing ko 'page I/O kam karta hai' likhna — ulta hai.

name: Misc (memory allocation, 3-level page table, EAT with dirty pages)
recognitionClueHinglish: Topic tag Page Replacement hai par question allocation ya address translation ka hai.
whatShouldComeToMind: Question ka asli concept pehchano (heap allocation / multilevel table / EAT) aur us topic ki method lagao.
generalSolvingApproach: 2. Virtual Memory topic ke patterns (page table size, EAT) reuse karo.
variationsObserved: EAT me dirty page ka extra replace time weighted karna.
commonTraps: Sab paths ki probability add karna bhool jaana.
